snippet.title: Catch Flex — Official Launch Trailer | Full-Body Rhythm Game, No VR
snippet.description:
Your body is the controller.

Catch Flex is a full-body rhythm game played with an ordinary camera — no VR headset, no gamepad, no wearables. Slash blocks, stomp the floor, catch rings, slide, kick, and dodge, all tracked limb by limb in real time.

▶ All platforms and stores: https://catchflex.com/

▶ Catch Flex on Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019004

▶ Catch Flex on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670810/Catch_Flex

▶ Catch Flex on Google Play (+Android TV): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.catchflex.game

▶ Catch Flex on Xbox: https://xbox.com/en-US/games/store/catch-flex-demo/9p4fw2rc08zv

▶ Catch Flex Controller, the free app that turns your phone into the tracking camera: https://controller.catchflex.com/

WHAT YOU NEED
A webcam, or your phone as the camera. Tracking runs entirely on your device — no video ever leaves it. Devices with no usable camera — a TV, a console, a Steam Deck — pair a phone running Catch Flex Controller, our free app that does the tracking and streams it to the game over local Wi-Fi.

WHAT'S IN IT
• 10 hand-charted tracks
• Six note types — cut blocks, rings, balls, stomps, slides, and obstacles
• Versus: two players side by side on one screen. Player two scans a QR code and their phone becomes the camera. Free, no account, no extra purchase
• Global leaderboards and achievements
• Menus controlled by motion — you never touch a controller
• One-time purchase. No ads, no subscription, no energy timers
